attributes.residual:
ONE OPCODE WORD plus a 66-word recolor. Aligned view at +0x1e0, verbatim:
  T 1e0: li r28,0        O 1e0: li r30,0        (regfield only)
  T 1e4: stw r28,0(r30)  O 1e4: stw r30,0(r29)  (regfield only - THIS WORD WAS AN OPCODE DIVERGENCE BEFORE THIS RECORD)
  T 1e8: li r31,0        O 1e8: mr r31,r30      (OPCODE)
RULE REQUEST, the artifact the work order asked for, with the full decode verdict. The surviving word is now the BEST-SHAPED inverse-copy-form customer in the corpus and the two bars that the run-49 screens recorded against it are gone: (a) POSITIONAL PAIRING - at +0x1e8 ours decodes ('copy',31,30) and the target ('li',31,0), i.e. the ours-copy -> target-li arrow that dominating_def_inverse is the named mode for; the old refusal '+0x1e0: target word 0x3b800000 is not a register copy' was against the WRONG OFFSET and no longer describes this function. (b) DESTINATION EQUALITY - both words write r31, so this is NOT the form-change-AND-recolor pair that LZ's unbuilt v2 combined stage would be needed for. (c) NO PERMUTATION IS REQUIRED - the streams are positionally aligned here, so C1's step-0 membership test, which refused every candidate order before, is not invoked at all. WHAT STILL BARS IT, and it is one thing: prove_constant_source must discharge that OUR r31 holds 0 at +0x1e8 from the `li r30,0` at +0x1e0, and +0x1e0 IS a jumptable case-entry (_jumptable_targets returns it among 19). The dominating definition is INSIDE the entry block and only two instructions earlier, with no interposed call and no other entry between - so unlike the run-49 reading, the value obligation here is discharged by a scan that starts AT the case entry rather than one that must cross it. A postprocessor lane should re-run prove_constant_source against +0x1e8 (NOT +0x1e0) before concluding anything; this lane did not author a rule because the work order reserves that for the postprocessor lane and because a source close must be tried first, which it was. NOT SOURCE-REACHABLE FURTHER: probes 2 and 4 above are two NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL results, i.e. statement shape cannot reach this decision, and the formal-passthrough matrix stays closed on its own eight measured points.
